newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ENGINEERING FIRM BBRC GETS NOD FOR SES LISTING.
newsitem.headline: ENGINEERING FIRM BBRC GETS NOD FOR SES LISTING.

text.p: Engineering company BBR Construction Systems Ltd (BBRC) said on Thursday it had obtained approval in principle for a listing on the second board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES).
It said in a statement going public would enable the company to raise capital to help fuel expansion into Southeast Asia.
Proceeds would also go toward expanding its core business in structural and ground engineering, and design and build services, it said.

"Given our technical sophistication and design capabilities, we are well positioned to capitalise on the region's massive infrastructural development needs," Andrew Tan, group managing director said in the statement.
The group has several major bridge construction, highway and building design projects in Singapore and Malaysia.
Its turnover has surged from S$4.8 million in 1994 to S$84 million in 1996, with profit before tax increasing from S$200,000 to S$5.6 million during the same period.
BBRC was incorporated in July 1993 by Switzerland Bureau BBR, a specialist engineering group.
